_doc: Classification of files for claude-bump-models. UPDATE paths get the literal-ID sweep; PRESERVE paths are skipped (historical claims, research attributions, deprecated-plan records); REVIEW paths hold mixed content — current routing guidance interleaved with historical benchmark/incident citations — so they are NEVER auto-rewritten: the model-upgrade skill walks them with per-line judgment (the scripts ignore this key). Note the sweep only matches full model-ID literals (claude-opus-4-7); prose forms ('Opus 4.7') are invisible to it — REVIEW files are where prose refs live. Globs relative to claude-bump-models' configured roots.

_preserve_rationale.AUTONOMOUS_VISUAL_DESIGN_ARCHITECTURE.md: Design Arena Feb 2026 ranking claims are historical facts; rewriting falsifies research record
_preserve_rationale.feedback-agent-team-models.md: Rule intentionally documents deprecated models (opus-4-6, sonnet-4-6) so future agents recognize which models are banned from Max-plan auto mode — sweeping these refs would strip the pedagogical content
_preserve_rationale.feedback-claude-code-2.1.111-112-regress: Incident memory references specific version histories that must not be rewritten
_preserve_rationale.auto-mode-setup.md: Binary-registry doc: documents the cli.js 2.1.114 hardcoded classifier (claude-sonnet-4-6) + decompiled auto-mode allowlist. Facts about the INSTALLED binary — updated only on a verified binary change (decompile / `claude auto-mode config`), never auto-swept on a model release. Sonnet 5 (2026-06-30) did not change the pinned binary's classifier or the auto-mode `sonnet` alias (still resolves to 4.6 at launch).
_preserve_rationale.MEMORY.md: Auto-memory index = historical provenance log; model refs in entries are timestamped records ('shipped X using model Y on date Z'). Auto-sweeping model IDs would corrupt the historical record (invariant: never rewrite provenance). Update entries deliberately, not via bump.
_preserve_rationale.platform-scaffolding.md: routines-v1 team-brief = completed-work artifact documenting the SHIPPED routine config schema enum (model: haiku-4-5 | sonnet-4-6). Bumping the enum would diverge the brief from the actual shipped code; it is historical. Refresh only alongside a verified schema/code change.
